description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for the fourth-order inhomogeneous-Dirichlet rule central_D2_4_dirichlet_bc driven by problems/heat_1d_dirichlet_o4.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding of N (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files. The manufactured solution exp(-alpha pi^2 t) sin(pi x) + gL + (gR - gL) x is exact for the continuous PDE with constant wall values gL = 0.5, gR = 1.5 (derivation in the problem file); the steady linear profile is discretely exact (all interior and boundary closure weight-sums are zero), so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure spatial-discretization error from the sine mode. Both the interior 5-point stencil and the one-sided boundary-row closures are O(dx^4) (Fornberg 1988 offset-node weights), so the error falls cleanly at fourth order: the Julia sweep gives median pairwise orders 3.98 (L2, pairwise 3.87/3.98/4.00) and 3.99 (Linf, pairwise 3.96/3.99/4.00) over n=8..64, converging to 4 with no boundary reduction — hence expected_order 4.0 with the tight 0.2 tolerance. Resolutions n=8..64 mirror the heat_1d_periodic_o4 sweep so the tiny high-order errors stay above the integrator temporal floor; tolerances are tightened to 1e-12/1e-14 so the errors stay spatial-dominated and cross-binding reproducible.
